doc.title: Howard Alden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997

title: Milt Hinton
summary: Alden recalls meeting Hinton with Bushkin and admires his support and sound.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: You mentioned a couple of times, one of our favorite people at Hamilton and that’s Milt Hinton. He’s quite a treasure, as is Mona.

Yeah. I met Milt when I first came to play with Joe Bushkin, and just felt at home with him. He’s always so supportive, and you know, he’s so supportive of younger musicians, older musicians, everybody. And there’s no one who ever played bass like him before, just the sound of his playing is just unbelievable.
